candidate_space.exhaustive_over: the seven declared coordinates and their declared values, and nothing wider.  It does not enumerate an augmentation that changes the event grammar again, that admits more than one further mark in one step, that supplies a datum the caller never presented, that groups marks by anything but the presented whole, or that derives the permitted renamings from the judgment grammar instead of declaring them (definition 16).  Every minimality statement below is scoped to this space

admitted boundary.buys_at_challenge_4: that a mark lies on a side at all, which sorts the four retained marks into two classes of two and no finer; every declared whole property but the index one and the tag one is formulable only under it, and so is the further-mark coordinate

requirement.declared: the two retained wholes are internally separable under a reading exactly when no permitted automorphism of the configuration carries the mark-set of one onto the mark-set of the other
requirement.grouping_is_metatheory: the grouping of marks into wholes is read off the caller's history and is no component of the regime.  The requirement is therefore a statement about the automorphisms of the state and about a grouping the state does not carry, and so is its declared witness, at every candidate that does not admit the grouping.  That is recorded as a narrowing of what internal separability can mean for a whole, and it is why the grouping is one of the declared coordinates
requirement.pointwise_sense: the Challenge 3 sense taken pointwise: every pair of distinct admitted marks is separable, no permitted automorphism carrying one to the other
requirement.readings_agree_because: membership in a whole's orbit under the permitted renamings is a property of a (configuration, mark-set) pair invariant under those renamings by construction, which rests on a premise stated here and checked by nothing, that a candidate's permitted renamings are closed under composition and inverse; it separates the two wholes exactly when no permitted automorphism carries one mark-set onto the other, so that half of the agreement is by unfolding and not a further fact.  What is computed at every point is the first reading against this declared witness, and not against the existential over every such property; the direction back from an arbitrary such property is the justifying sentence below, which is prose
requirement.second_reading: some property of a mark-set that forgets whatever the candidate's declared key forgets, and that is invariant under every permitted renaming, holds of one retained whole's mark-set and not of the other's

C3-X.O_clause_fact: the frozen clause reads 'the requirement will therefore fail again under U, with the same minimum count of one, and hold again under O with no new declaration', and its falsifier names 'the O requirement needing a new declaration'.  Under O the requirement FAILS: the exchange of the two wholes is a permitted automorphism of the retained configuration that uses no side exchange, so the withdrawal reading O carries does not touch it.  The falsifier fired, and with it the clause that the boundary contributes here exactly what it contributed at Challenge 3, where that contribution met the requirement under O
C3-X.evidence: the Challenge 1 reader refuses both inscriptions and the widening is paid by the run; the retained placement is (0, 1, 0, 1) with two marks on each side and a side-exchanging automorphism under U; the requirement fails under U at a minimum capability count of one; it fails under O as well; neither side-reading whole property separates the two wholes; and the cross-boundary matching is internally unavailable at the retained configuration under both readings
C3-X.label: NOT FORCED

C4-1.evidence: the Challenge 1 reader refuses both inscriptions by name; the caller's history is a supply and an occurrence admission for each of four marks; the current configuration under each reading is placement (0, 1, 0, 1) with labels a, b, b, a, certified, replayed from genesis, and matching the placement the declarations predict; and the other within-whole order gives an isomorphic configuration
C4-1.label: FORCED
C4-1.result_basis: DEFINITION-level: the Challenge 1 refusal is that rung's declared bound replayed on the caller's text, and the retained configuration follows from the widened reader, the declared convention, the declared within-whole order, and the Challenge 2 identity policy, all of them declarations; a hit is by construction and is not counted as content.  The one clause that is not a declaration, that the other within-whole order gives an isomorphic configuration, is an isomorphism-witness search and is reported separately

C4-2.evidence: the requirement fails under BOTH readings; the witness under O uses no side exchange, so the withdrawal reading O carries does not touch it; of the six pairs of marks exactly the four lying on different sides are separable under O and none is separable under U
C4-2.label: FORCED
C4-2.result_basis: content: whether an automorphism carries one whole's mark-set onto the other's is a search over the unpruned enumeration at the reading's own renamings, and both values are attained elsewhere in the space; the pair census is a search per pair

C4-3.evidence: neither side-reading whole property separates the two wholes under either reading; the configuration in which the second whole's copy of the first token is a token the caller never presented is isomorphic to the retained one under both readings; and keeping the presentation labels meets the requirement under O and does not meet it under U
C4-3.label: NOT FORCED
C4-3.result_basis: content: the invariance of each declared whole property is a census over the declared domain under the candidate's own renamings, and the cross-boundary matching is an isomorphism-witness search

C4-4.evidence: seven coordinates and 192 points under each reading; a point is one step exactly when its capability count is one; every point of count two or more is refused as bundling; and naming the wholes without admitting the grouping collapses into the base under the implemented quotient
C4-4.label: NOT FORCED
C4-4.result_basis: DEFINITION-level: the coordinates, their values, the capability named for each, and therefore the point count and the identity of one-step with capability count one are declarations of this rung; a hit is by construction and is not counted as content

C4-5.evidence: under U exactly one one-step point meets the requirement, the withdrawal of the mark permutations, at a minimum capability count of one and in one class, so uniqueness is not refuted inside the declared space; the withdrawal of the side exchange and both further-mark points do not meet it
C4-5.label: FORCED
C4-5.result_basis: content: which one-step points meet the requirement is a search at each candidate's own renamings, and the class count is the implemented quotient.  That the one minimum meets the requirement by unfolding is DEFINITION-level and the receipt reports it separately

C4-6.evidence: under O exactly two one-step points meet the requirement, the withdrawal of the mark permutations and the keeping of the presentation labels, in two classes tied at capability count one, so uniqueness is refuted under O
C4-6.label: FORCED
C4-6.result_basis: content: the same search and the same quotient, under the other reading

C4-7.evidence: the grouping alone does not meet the requirement, the names alone are a no-op that collapses into the base, and the two together meet it under both readings at a capability count of two, so the augmentation that gives the caller internal wholes is refused as a bundle
C4-7.label: FORCED
C4-7.result_basis: content: each cell of the grouping square is an automorphism search with both values attained, and the collapse of the name-wholes point is the implemented quotient

C4-8.evidence: the pointwise sense implies the whole sense at every point of the space under both readings; the converse fails at the points under U where the grouping is admitted and the wholes are named; and at the Challenge 3 configuration, where each whole is one mark, the two senses agree under both readings
C4-8.label: FORCED
C4-8.result_basis: content: the pointwise sense is a search per pair, the whole sense a search per whole, and their comparison a census over the 192 points; the reduction is computed at the Challenge 3 configuration and not asserted

tally.criterion: a prediction counts as content only if at least one of its hitting clauses, read literally, rests on a theorem outside the DEFINITION-level lists of the paper's section 7 or on a computation not fixed by a declaration alone; a prediction whose every clause is true by unfolding a declaration, or reports a modelling decision of the run, is HIT by construction and not counted as content

what_the_challenge_exercises.admission: yes: the caller retains, so the caller's history contains one occurrence admission per mark; the further-mark candidate would be the first event the process rather than the caller issues, and it is a candidate and is admitted by no history the receipt reports as current
what_the_challenge_exercises.current-state designation: yes: the current state under each reading is the replay of the caller's Challenge 4 history; every candidate configuration is the replay of an explicit history and only the base is current
what_the_challenge_exercises.equality: yes: structural regime equality, the isomorphism relation at the reading's renamings, and the isomorphism relation at a candidate's renamings over configurations rather than regimes are three different relations, and the rung uses all three
what_the_challenge_exercises.mention: yes: each visible mark is named by two events of the caller's history, once in each whole, and is not an identity
what_the_challenge_exercises.observation: yes: four mark-on-side judgments, and under a candidate the side-name form; no new form is needed and none is added to the closed grammar
what_the_challenge_exercises.retention: yes: the placement tuple carries all four marks, and the grouping the caller's history fixes is metatheory beside it
what_the_challenge_exercises.side: yes, and it is the rung's subject: each side now carries one mark of each whole, which is why the boundary alone no longer meets the requirement under either reading
what_the_challenge_exercises.supply: yes: one Supply per mark of each presented whole, four in all, in presented order; the further-mark candidate needs no new one
